trace.title: Düşünce
trace.detail:
Key findings:
- T0112, T0104, T0136, T0144 all heading east (toward base, bearing 102, heading_vs_base 0-35), moving now, ETAs 24–47 min. Converging convoy-like approach — DİKKAT.
- T0090 van, erratic pattern, closed to 2356m then back out, closing rate 0, eta null — izle.
- T0074: was near base (942m) for 95 min, then moved away fast, now heading NW away — normal/izle.
- T0120: circling loop near frame (path 27km, net disp 17m) — patrol-like, izle.
- T0223: stationary 120 min, no detection — possibly parked vehicle; R032 "kamyon uzun suredir hareketsiz" matches T0223 location though report says truck, detection absent.
- R017: "5 kamyon durdu" — but detections are 4 cars + 1 van, no trucks → çelişiyor/kısmen.
- D8 conf 0.06 at frame edge, no track → likely false alarm. Verify D8 and maybe D7/T0223 visually.
